'''Post group''' was a group of two [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|''Delta''-class JV-7 escort shuttles]] that served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. They were in the [[Recapture of Outpost D-34|Second Battle of Javin]] where they were destroyed by the [[Frigate/Legends|Frigate]] [[Fogger]].
